ac_results.ac: `src/parse.mjs` exports `parse(text)` returning `{ pairs, problems }`; `node --test test/parse.test.mjs` exits 0 (covers: REQ-10, REQ-18)
a line starting with `#` yields no pair and no problem (covers: REQ-12)
blank lines yield no pair and no problem, and later line numbers still count them (covers: REQ-13)
`parse("A=1\nJUNK")` yields problem `{line: 2}`; `1BAD=x` and `A="open` each yield a problem at their 1-based line (covers: REQ-17)
`src/parse.mjs` contains no `import` statement — a test reads the file and asserts it (covers: REQ-27, REQ-18)
`parse` never throws on `"="`, `"\0\n'"`, or a long random string — asserted in the test (covers: REQ-7)

assumptions: A duplicate key removes the earlier pair and appends the later one (last wins, carrying the later line)
A quoted value must end with the same quote as its opener; trailing text after a closing quote counts as unterminated
